SLAM's own order of operations. A step can declare a prerequisite step (reached first: every step before it that counts is done) and conditions on the numbers. A locked step shows a lock and its plain reason, is never where you are, and never counts as a hole. Unlock anyway needs a note (kept on the session record) and shows the cost in FI days a year, coach only.
Bedazzle your basic life: the joy lines (goals and mindset live here too)
Stop the bleeding: no late bills, payday debt at $0, little e full ($1,000 or the highest deductible, whichever is smaller), income gaps within 12 months covered
Take the free money: the full employer match
Clear the heavy debt: cards, payday, personal, medical, BNPL, or any APR at or over the heavy line (8%)
big e: the Rule of 5 months, FAT first, then DRAFTT, then full spending
